connector.name: OpenMandate
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for OpenMandate - find cofounders and early teammates beyond your network. 15 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.openmandate.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.openmandate, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key in Bearer format: Bearer om_live_... — get one at https://openmandate.ai/api-keys
